text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n♪ Today's lunch is
a piping-hot carrot hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It goes so well with cheese, after all!
Cheese! Cheese, cheese, chee... se.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where's my grated parmesan cheese?!
...C-Could it be... back at the dorm...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: M-My cheese hamburg steak that I worked so hard for...
